# Compliance-constrained ballistic transport: exact optimum or stiff-mode escape

27 October 2026. Original construction/integration in this owned trajectory. Frozen governing sources: F (complete attainable-spectrum inverse and unconstrained full-Bose theorem), C and A (exact static CM compliance moment). The all-frequency three-moment root lemma was independently derived by the authorised helper; its complete self-contained proof is in `helper/PROOF.md`. Numerical signs stated below are exact enclosures from `certify.py`, not frequency sampling. No historical-priority, specimen, material or practical-device claim is made.

## 1. The fixed physical model and a useful spectral variable

Fix a backbone mass m, total cell mass M>m, intercell spring K>0, temperature theta>0, and a finite positive CM compliance cap Cmax. Put

S=4K, A0=S/m, B=S/M, ms=M-m,
dmax=S ms² Cmax/M².

Every admitted finite connected positive scalar spring/mass network has a full band indicator chi with disjoint acoustic/optical bands and 0<=chi<=1. After dark-band cancellation its exact resources are

T(chi)=integral 2w chi(w)dw=A0,
L(chi)=integral [chi-1_[0,sqrt(B)]]/w dw=0,
W(chi)=integral [chi-1_[0,sqrt(B)]]/w³ dw
      =-ms² C_CM/(2M)>=-dmax/(2B).

These are full-spectrum identities. The objective is J(chi)=integral g_theta(w)chi(w)dw with g_theta=[w/(2theta)/sinh(w/(2theta))]². Physical conductance is k_B J/(2pi).

For A>B and r>0 define p,s by

p²+s²-r²=A, p²s²/r²=B, 0<p<r<s,

or, explicitly,

s²=[r²+A+sqrt((r²+A)²-4Br²)]/2, p²=Br²/s².

Let chi_(A,r)=1_[0,p]+1_[r,s] and j(A,r)=J(chi_(A,r)). This is an actual one-pendant spectrum with backbone S/A and total mass M. Its regularized cubic moment is

W(chi_(A,r))=-(A-B)/(2B r²).

When A<A0 this is an effective heavier-backbone object. Its W is compared with the original fixed-m physical cap; it is not assigned the effective cell's own unrescaled CM compliance.

## 2. General exact infimum theorem

**Theorem.** The infimum of J over all admitted finite networks with the original fixed m,M,K,theta and C_CM<=Cmax equals

j*=min { j(A,r): B<A<=A0, r>0, (A-B)/r²<=dmax }.

The right side has a unique minimizing active spectrum and a unique pair (A*,r*). There are two possibilities:

1. If A*=A0, the infimum is attained by the actual one-pendant cell of mass m, side mass ms and spring k=r*² m ms/M. No extra passive mode can improve it.

# A compliance-constrained phonon frontier with a topology change

The subsequent `JOINT_CAP_PROOF.md` strengthens Section 3 to a globally
optimal finite two-pendant cell under C_CM<=1/20 and total spring sum<=24.
It removes the open optimization gap for that particular joint-budget
point; the general resource phase diagram remains open.

All statements below concern the exact scalar, rank-one, harmonic,
ideal-contact ballistic model of frozen sources F and C. Throughout,
the actual backbone mass is **m=1**, total cell mass **M=2**, intercell
spring **K=1**, and temperature **theta=1/2**. The objective, before the
common factor k_B/(2 pi), is

    J(chi) = integral_0^infinity g(w) chi(w) dw,
    g(w) = (w/sinh w)^2.

No actual elastic material, connector mass, three-dimensional polarization,
disorder, anharmonicity, finite contact or measurement is claimed.

## 1. The exact resources and an all-frequency certificate

Let chi be the complete passband indicator of any connected finite positive
internal mass/spring network in the stated model. Source F proves
0 <= chi <= 1, the rank-one trace identity, the regularized logarithmic
identity, and full positive-star inverse realization. Source C, with the
consistent sign convention audited in A, proves the additional compliance
identity. At our resources these read

    T(chi) = integral 2 w chi(w) dw = 4,
    integral [chi-1_[0,sqrt2]]/w dw = 0,
    D(chi) = integral [1_[0,sqrt2]-chi]/w^3 dw = C_CM/4.

Every difference integral used below is finite: two connected finite
spectra agree with one on some interval next to zero and have bounded
frequency support. Dark bands cancel and do not invalidate these identities.

Suppose a strict two-band indicator chi_* has positive edges p<r<s and
define its exact interpolated multipliers by

    F(w) = w^3 g(w) + lambda w^2 + 2 mu w^4 - eta,
    F(p)=F(r)=F(s)=0.

Interpolation at the three distinct squared edges determines the multipliers
uniquely. If mu>0 and eta>0, then F has exactly these three positive roots,
all simple, and

    F<0 on (0,p) union (r,s),
    F>0 on (p,r) union (s,infinity).

The same conclusion holds when mu=0, lambda>0, eta>0. This criterion requires
no assumed sign for lambda when mu>0.

Here is a self-contained proof of the all-frequency root assertion. Multiply
F by the positive factor sinh^2(w)/w^2 to obtain the entire function

statement: In the stated scalar single-backbone ideal-contact harmonic model, a CM-compliance cap gives a unique two-band optimum or a nonattained stiff-mode escape infimum. At normalized m=1,M=2,K=1,theta=1/2, exact joint caps C<=1/20 and total internal spring sum<=24 or<=20.02 admit finite globally optimal two-pendant cells.
